Records.authors: Mikhail V. Kompaniets and Erik Panzer
Records.description: massless propagator computed for the $\varphi^4$ 6-loop calculation available from the ancillary files p_int_g2.mpl (Maple) and p_int_g2.m (Mathematica) of the arXiv submission results are rational linear combinations of multiple zeta values. The pInt[3,1] period for this 3-loop 5-propagator topology is imported here as a Result: value = Cfull^3 * (anc g2 period), cross-checked against the existing independent library computation of the same integral.
Records.verifiedVia: cross-checked low-loop import (validation policy 2026-06-22). value_ST = Cfull^3 * anc[pInt[3,1]], with Cfull = Exp[eps*EulerGamma] Gamma[1+eps] Gamma[1-eps]^2/Gamma[2-2eps] converting the ancillary G-scheme normalization to the SubTropica normalization per loop (Cfull verified independently at L=4 and L=5 by pySD-Euclidean). The ancillary period is from Kompaniets-Panzer (arXiv:1705.06483; peer-reviewed HyperInt; trusted). VERIFIED by cross-check against the existing INDEPENDENT library computation of the same integral: the entry's existing independent library Result for the same single-scale massless propagator integral (leading orders confirmed to agree at unit scale). The CNI->anc bridge is confirmed by an explicit vertex isomorphism {1->2, 2->1, 3->3} (anc->lib; brute-force). NOT validated against HyperFLINT/STIntegrate (a HyperInt reimplementation -> circular).

source.title: Minimally subtracted six loop renormalization of O(n)-symmetric phi^4 theory and critical exponents
source.ancFile: anc/p_int_g2.m -> pInt[3,1]  (g2 = genuine phi^4 propagator periods)

import.method: Single-scale phi^4 propagator integral, external scale restored. value = (p^2)^{1 - 3 eps} * Cfull^3 * anc[pInt[3,1]]: the KP G-scheme period series (Cfull = Exp[eps*EulerGamma] Gamma[1+eps] Gamma[1-eps]^2/Gamma[2-2eps], G-scheme -> SubTropica normalization per loop) with the external Euclidean invariant restored, so the stored value is the dimensionful momentum-space integral, not the p^2=1 reduced form. g2: genuine phi^4 propagator self-energy; 2L-V=1; I ~ (p2)^{1 - 3 eps}; mass dimension (mass)^2. p2 = -MM > 0 : the spacelike (mostly-plus) external invariant, = minus the package mostly-minus Euclidean MM (MM<0; conventions.md L918-924). value = (p2)^{1 - 3 eps} * (dimensionless p2=1 form) is REAL for p2>0 (KP G-scheme). At the pySD anchor MM=-1, i.e. p2=+1, the scale factor is 1, reproducing the anchored period; the i*pi tower appears only on continuation to timelike p2<0 (MM>0). NOT computed by STIntegrate/HyperFLINT (a HyperInt reimplementation; using it to validate the ancillary HyperInt value would be circular).
